entries.title: Ask your first mate to pin or unpin a task
entries.body: Tell your first mate to pin a task and it moves to the Pinned section at the top of Tasks, whatever state it is in; ask it to unpin and the task goes back under its state. The task's record says your first mate pinned or unpinned it.
entries.noPicture: Asking puts the task in the same Pinned section the pin button already shows, so there is no new view to picture.
